defects.description: Enum spelling mismatch: server emits "canceled" (US spelling), documented contract and client both use "cancelled" (UK spelling) -- isCancelled() never matches, so the banner never appears.
Units mismatch: contract documents `amount` as dollars, server actually returns `amountCents` (cents) -- client formatAmount() will display amounts 100x too small.

Nothing enforces the documented contract against the actual response shape (no contract/schema test) -- the doc and code can silently diverge again after this fix, which is the underlying reason two mismatches accumulated at once.
